name: Road Rage Simulator
desc:
🚗 Welcome to Road Rage Simulator! ⭐ WEEKLY UPDATES!

Build your strength by lifting heavy vehicles and gain immense muscle! Then, destroy a row of cars to earn amazing rewards and get to the next world! Hatch eggs to collect cool pets, unlock heavier weights and equip powerful auras to become the strongest player in the game!

💥 Smash through cars!
💪 Train to get bigger and stronger!
⚡️ Unlock amazing abilities!
🥚 Hatch eggs to find powerful pets!
🗺️ Explore and unlock new worlds!

🗣️ Join our group for special rewards!
⭐Lagging? Join a free private server!

❤️ Developed by the team at Gamefast
